spanish: Y trajo el arca al mishkán, y puso la parójet del masaj, y cubrió sobre el arca del testimonio, conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a Moisés.

findings.issue: Common noun left untranslated as mishkán; the token licenses a Spanish common noun, not a Hebraized lemma.
Common noun in construct left untranslated as parójet; the token licenses a Spanish common noun.
Definite common noun left untranslated as masaj; the token licenses a Spanish common noun.

notes: Brought, put, covered over the ark of the testimony, and Jehovah commanded Moses match the remaining tokens.
